name: Time
q: Strike while the iron is hot
Truth is the daughter of time
Waste of time is the greatest waste
Time is like a river that sweeps all away
Life is short, art is long
An inch of time beats a foot of jade
Time keeps a different pace for each
Lost time is never found again
Time, the devourer of all things
Dost thou love life? Then do not squander time, for that is the stuff life is made of
Time is a child at play
Ground I may recover; time, never
Time shows the hidden, hides the shown
Life is a white horse past a gap
